baseline: MOM60 unchanged dm_trainonly.build_momentum(res60s1) then smooth(alpha=.25); recompute on matched calendar/accounting. No optional SLOW_CONTROL needed for component identification.
train_window: 2008-11-04 through 2016-03-31 expanding input history; no fitting

walk_forward_folds.evaluation: 2011 calendar year, last two exchange dates purged; 2016 partial
2012 calendar year, last two exchange dates purged; 2016 partial
2013 calendar year, last two exchange dates purged; 2016 partial
2014 calendar year, last two exchange dates purged; 2016 partial
2015 calendar year, last two exchange dates purged; 2016 partial
2016 calendar year, last two exchange dates purged; 2016 partial

confirmation_policy: All Train is previously studied development history, not independent OOS. Historical Valid never accessed.

feature_definitions.StockMom60: sum of last60 finite residual observations after within-segment shift(1), min_periods60; existing60-observation definition, reset on >20 absent exchange-date ordinal gap. Pre-rank value, not centered rank, for meaningful economic sign. No horizon search.
feature_definitions.Sector17Mom: same-date PIT17 equal mean of finite StockMom60 peers EXCLUDING own stock; minimum10 finite peers
feature_definitions.Sector33Mom: same-date PIT33 equal mean of finite StockMom60 peers EXCLUDING own stock; minimum5 finite peers
feature_definitions.PIT: Exact same(Date,Code) join only, missing classification excluded. Unclassified17=99/33=9999 excluded, no latest/backfill. Peer universe only raw_return rows present on date; full listed universe is never added.
feature_definitions.missing: raw component NaN on insufficient peers/history/sector; adapter neutral0, retain every required row. Coverage gate uses raw finite component BEFORE neutral filling. Own StockMom missing does not remove finite peer common score.
feature_definitions.Breadth: leave-one-out finite positive StockMom peers / finite peers; diagnostic only

model: Three fixed standalone raw component scores; no fit, ranking transform, smoothing, combination or overlay. Official scorer supplies quintiles.
selection_rule: First require ALL feasibility gates: pooled RankIC>0, pooled/ex2016 GrossSR>0, >=3/5 full years annual gross>0, raw finite evaluation coverage>=.95, turnover<=unchanged MOM60. Short-improvement claim additionally needs annual Short gross>0 and both annual Short gross/net>=MOM60. Next-experiment eligibility (not release adoption): feasibility plus pooled/ex2016 NetSR>0, pooled NetSR>MOM60, >=4/5 full-year NetSR improvements, paired deltaNetSR95% lower>0, positive quintile monotonicity, and Short gate. Otherwise REJECT fixed candidate. Concentration/LOSO are descriptive only, never selection/exclusion rules. No combination in this experiment.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block over concatenated eligible signal dates

diagnostics.agreement: A(++), B(+-), C(-+), D(--); zeros/missing separate. Target mean, within-bucket StockMom/SectorMom RankIC, fixed portfolio short contribution and equal-short target mean, no candidate/filter.
diagnostics.breadth: same-date sector-universe median for high/low SectorMom, breadth>=.5 broad positive and <.5 broad weakness; descriptive splits fixed before results
diagnostics.concentration: Q1/Q5 sector17/33 shares, long/short gross exposure, gross/net contributions, daily HHI/max normalized absolute/side sector weights
diagnostics.LOSO: subtract each PIT sector contribution from existing portfolio, preserve remaining positions and attributed costs, NO reranking/renormalization
diagnostics.correlations: daily Pearson and Spearman, pooled raw Pearson and pooled same-date demeaned Pearson; all five requested pairs
diagnostics.persistence: adjacent exchange-date rank autocorrelation, quintile retention, Q1/Q5 spell lengths with universe/date gaps reset and censored spells identified
